app.name: NaWeAgree
app.tagline: So you both remember the same thing
app.meta.description: Write it down. Both see it. Both agree — before money changes hands. For tailors, mechanics, artisans, and anyone tired of ‘I thought you said…’
cta.agreeVersion: I have seen and I agree with {version}
status.invited: Waiting for them to open the link
status.stalled: No reply for a week — nudge them?
error.generic: Something went wrong — we logged it. Try again.
error.offline: You're offline. Your last action is saved and will send when you're back.
error.conflict: Someone posted a new version while you were typing. We've loaded the latest — review it and try again.
error.state: This plan isn't ready for that yet.
receipt.title: Your signed record
receipt.subtitle: Save this file somewhere safe. Either of you can re-upload it later to prove what you agreed.
receipt.notContract: This is a shared record, not a legal contract.
receipt.verify.ok: Signature matches — this is a genuine NaWeAgree record.
receipt.verify.bad: This doesn't look like one of our receipts (signature didn't match).
receipt.verify.dev: Signature matches, but it was signed with the development key — not a production record.
privacy.title: Your data, your call
privacy.subtitle: NDPR gives you rights over your data. You don't need to email anyone — use the buttons below.
privacy.export: Export everything NaWeAgree holds about you (plans you started or joined) as a JSON file.
privacy.delete: Delete everything tied to this device. Your name will be removed from plans; this cannot be undone.
privacy.pending: We're working on your request — it will be ready shortly.
privacy.ready: Your export is ready to download.
abuse.title: Report something wrong
abuse.subtitle: If someone is using NaWeAgree to harass, scam, or impersonate, tell us. A human reads every report.
offline.title: You're offline
offline.subtitle: You can still read plans you opened before. New messages will send when you're back online.
principles.title: Our four promises
principles.1.title: Silence is never agreement
principles.1.body: Nothing counts until someone actively taps ‘I have seen and I agree.’ No pre-ticked boxes.
principles.2.title: Changes are a new version
principles.2.body: Edited plans don't overwrite the old ones. Everyone re-reviews the new version.
principles.3.title: Your words, not ours
principles.3.body: No AI fills in terms for you. You write what you agreed, in your own words.
principles.4.title: Either person can walk away
principles.4.body: Withdrawing is one tap. A plan isn't a cage — it's a shared memory.
footer.tagline: Built for markets, workshops, and honest work across Nigeria.
legal.notContract: This is a shared record, not a legal contract.
